rows.text: Seriously, when is this Wardance going to start? The Skysplitter has been hovering there for ages. When can we board and see what's inside?
rows.speaker: Excited Outworlder Tourist

rows.text: Is this how long-life species live? Everything proceeds so slowly. The effectiveness of "anticipation" in my emotional center is at an all-time high. Oh, I need to drink some coolant.
rows.speaker: Expectant Outworlder Tourist

rows.text:
After the Shackling Prison Break

On the Starskiff Haven streets
Starskiff Haven Street
Relax, the Realm-Keeping Commission will send boarding notices to all ticket holders. The gazette said the Skysplitter will fire a salute before the ceremony starts!
rows.speaker: Xianzhou Local Resident

rows.text: I saw the schedule for the first day of the tournament. Can you believe the ringmaster accepted four challenges? And he's just a kid! So, who are you betting on, Bardeau?
rows.speaker: Excited Outworlder Tourist

rows.text: I'm betting on neither. I lost all my credits betting on Roboball games in Taikiyan. This time, I've decided not to rely on probability games to accomplish my target of "getting rich"...
rows.speaker: Expectant Outworlder Tourist

rows.text: Wardance...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: There you are, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I heard you and Mr. Dan Heng went to meet the judges, and then a riot broke out in The Shackling Prison. I was so worried about you. Thank goodness, you both made it out safe.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Discuss what happened...
There was a revolt in The Shackling Prison... Fortunately, we were protected by the guards until the Cloud Knights arrived to rescue us.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: What happened on your end?
What's your plan now?
I was planning to take Miss March and Yunli to Stargazer Navalia to see the Skysplitter up close, but we stumbled upon a group of suspicious foxians carrying official identities.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: They were acting strange, so out of curiosity, we decided to follow them. It turns out that they were actually borisin disguised as foxians!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: It seems they infiltrated Stargazer Navalia in order to prepare for Hoolay's escape, and we foiled their plans by pure chance.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I wonder who provided them with those disguises, and how many more borisin have taken advantage of the Wardance to infiltrate the ship?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: The borisin traveled all the way here to infiltrate the Luofu and attempt to rescue their leader with a crafty scheme... This is completely unlike them. To be honest, it reminds me of what the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus did during the Ambrosial Arbor Crisis.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: At present, all three generals are on guard and taking action to hunt down the fugitives and the mastermind behind it all, in order to prevent further trouble.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: However, if these borisin can disguise themselves as foxians... where do we even begin to search for them?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Those tourists over there are talking about you...
Yeah, I heard them, too, but I'm afraid I'll have to disappoint them. I've already reported to General Jing Yuan that I'll give up my role as the ringmaster.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: What? You're not going to defend the ring?
But haven't you been preparing for it for so long?
The security of the Luofu is more important to me than anything else. I need to fulfill my duties as a Cloud Knight Lieutenant before taking on the honor of being a ringmaster.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Those tourists just want to see some good sword fights. Anyone can participate in this kind of tournament. It doesn't have to be me.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: The real challenge lies beyond the ring on the Skysplitter. If we don't capture the fugitives soon, Hoolay will wreak havoc.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Obviously, there is someone behind the scenes orchestrating this prison break, intending to spread chaos. If we fail to thwart their evil plan, what honor will be left for us to uphold?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Well said.
You may be tiny in stature, but your ambition matches that of the Yaoqing's warriors.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Hey, this has nothing to do with my height.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: What brings you here, General?
I thought all the generals were on the move already?
Yes, I suggested to Yanqing that we find a place to have a decent meal. A hunter must be well-fed before "the hunt."
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You still have a good appetite even in the face of disaster — you truly are the Merlin's Claw... Please, finish the food quickly so we can get to work, General Feixiao.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Well, that's not up to me... Dig in. I called you here so you could enjoy the food.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Me? This isn't the time for a leisurely meal... and this is way too much for me!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Oh? You'd give me time to enjoy a meal but not yourself?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Ever since you encountered those borisin spies, you've been so busy that you've hardly eaten anything. You can't defeat Hoolay on an empty stomach.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Take your time. Enjoy the meal and calm yourself.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Hoolay's whereabouts are still unknown, and they've even taken Mr. Jiaoqiu hostage. The longer we wait, the more complicated the situation becomes.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Jiaoqiu always said I'm the most impatient person among the Cloud Knights, and I can't argue with that. So there's no reason for you to be more anxious than me.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I've fought against borisin abominations for years, and I know their ferocity and cunning well. The borisin were clearly well-prepared for this prison break, and now they are staying in the shadows. They have no reason to rush out into the open.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: When facing cunning and ferocious prey, the hunter must be more patient, biding their time to seize the golden chance for a decisive blow. Once Hoolay loses his patience and reveals himself, that's when we'll strike.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: But when will that time come?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text:
Three dual-hours before the Wardance convenes

In The Shackling Prison
In the Shackling Prison
Like I said... it's only one meal away.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Should the Wardance really be held as scheduled?
March is right, Grandpa. I heard the escaped prisoner from The Shackling Prison is beyond formidable. In case anything goes wrong...
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Which two parties?

The first are the many travelers who have come all the way here for the Wardance. If we declare martial law now, it's like declaring that the Luofu isn't safe. How do you think the outsiders would react? They'd be terrified, and chaos might ensue.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Are you suggesting that I take Yanqing's place as ringmaster?
Are you suggesting that Yunli takes Yanqing's place as ringmaster?
Are you planning to take up the role of the ringmaster yourself, General Huaiyan?
Master Yunli, is General Huaiyan asking you to be the ringmaster instead of Yanqing?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Of course I'll do my part, but not on the Skysplitter.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: General Huaiyan... Are you asking me... to take Yanqing's place... as the ringmaster?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I am sorry for our improper management, and I truly appreciate your assistance, General.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: There is no need to apologize. We Cloud Knights fight on the battlefield, while you judges punish the criminals. We are two sides of the same Xianzhou Luofu, and it is my honor to serve the Ten-Lords Commission.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I've grasped the situation of the prison break. Now, tell me more about the current state of The Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Borisin infiltrated the prison in disguise and released the prisoners, spreading chaos.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Among the judges on duty in the four divisions, Judge Xueyi from the Detention Division was killed and is temporarily unavailable. So, I'm taking over her duties and commanding Aurumaton Spectral Envoys and spiritfarers to quickly restore order in the affected areas.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: I, and the two behind me, will go deeper into the prison to investigate.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: But General, the situation inside is still chaotic and perilous. Your presence would be...
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: It's common for Cloud Knight generals to face danger directly. Hoolay has escaped, and the Yaoqing envoy is being held hostage by the borisin. His fate is unknown. This is a grave matter.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Not only did the Merlin's Claw offer no reproach, she decided to go after Hoolay herself to prevent further calamity. I believe the Luofu owes her something in return for her fervent determination...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: How did the infiltrators learn about the location where Hoolay was held? And how did they time their plan just before the Yaoqing messengers were ready to escort him...?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Finding the answers to these questions shouldn't be too difficult. What truly matters is if we can gather the clues that lead us to the mastermind behind all of this.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I understand, but I'm afraid it won't be an easy task.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: For a long time, this hidden force has been pursuing their own goals and undermining the security of the Luofu. Backing down now will only encourage them to further endanger the peace here.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The Ten-Lords Commission will support your decision with everything we have, General.
rows.speaker: Hanya

rows.text: Dan Heng and Lingsha, I'll need both of you to accompany me on this challenging journey.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Well, it's part of my responsibilities as the Cauldron Master. So, where would you like to start, General?
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Let's start with those borisin disguised as foxians.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: My people have already prepared the evidence.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Borisin have fast metabolisms, so the effects of medicines don't last long...
An infiltration technique the general is familiar with...
Indeed. This means that these borisin have a steady supply of the medicine within the Luofu.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: The formula and technique seem oddly familiar.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. Looks like the Alchemy Commission is involved once again.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Here we are. According to the judge, this area is not yet under control, so we should proceed cautiously.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: I've captured the nature of the medicine in my censer.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: By following the medicinal fumes, we should be able to retrace the steps of the disguised borisin.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: (Examine the remains of the warden)
Incredible strength... The attacker shattered this warden's bones with a single blow.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: The wolf-shaped mech disintegrates into a pile of metal.
Yanqing told me that an IPC ship was attacked by borisin. Is this what they were transporting on the ship?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: A biomimetic weapon that will auto-restart even after being turned off...
The Intelligentsia Guild's research on the traits of longevity...
Yes, the Artisanship Commission and Alchemy Commission conducted a joint examination and found that... the parts of this machine are made from specially refined borisin bio-tissue.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: I heard the Intelligentsia Guild has been researching the biological properties of long-life species, hoping to make medical or combat-related discoveries. However, they haven't dared to cross any lines due to their so-called "relationship" with the Alliance.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Perhaps to those scholars, borisin are no different from lab animals. Maybe the borisin attacked that ship to retaliate against the Intelligentsia Guild for experimenting on them?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No, if it were only about revenge, they could just wreck the ship and destroy all the cargo, instead of allowing it to end up in The Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: It was a deliberate display to showcase the dangerous nature of the "cargo" in broad daylight. This way, the cargo would end up in The Shackling Prison, serving as a tool for the prison break.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: This skill in exploiting the blind spots of others' mindsets is so atypical of them. I'm afraid the IPC and the Intelligentsia Guild unknowingly became their accomplices.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Something seems to be hiding in the pile of metal on the ground, ready to move.
Watch out. This thing is still alive!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The giant machine goes silent again. Like a wounded beast drained of blood, it can no longer move.

You haven't answered my question about why Hoolay was imprisoned in the Luofu instead of the Yaoqing, General. You've been reserved in your response. Could it be that such an arrangement wasn't an honor?
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: The reason why the marshal didn't leave Hoolay on the Yaoqing lies in the very mech in front of us.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: ...Are you suggesting that there are people trying to understand Hoolay's secrets and use them for their own purposes, just like with this mech?
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Well, I understand. I've heard that the foxians on the Yaoqing share a bloodline with the borisin, and just like the borisin, some of the foxians there experience an uncontrollable insanity called Moon Rage.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: The marshal believed that this would be inhumane and no different from what the borisin did, so...
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Exactly. While borisin see Moon Rage as a blessing that unlocks their true potential, foxians see it as an inevitable curse within their bloodline. Countless healers of the Yaoqing have attempted to unravel this mystery, but to no avail.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: "Why can borisin control the power of Moon Rage?" "Can we foxians break free from this curse?" ...These questions were asked frequently.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Each questioner had good intentions, but the road to catastrophe is paved with good intentions.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: To the foxians of the Yaoqing, Hoolay was not only the Warhead of the borisin but also a monster that could be the subject of much research. Hoolay thus became a poison that corrupted people's minds without their knowing.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: That's why the marshal decided to imprison Hoolay in the Luofu. It wasn't an honor but rather... a warning.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Because such selfish pursuits in the name of "good intentions" once led to a tragedy on the Luofu that served as a warning to future generations.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The Sedition of Imbibitor Lunae.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: By imprisoning Hoolay in the Xianzhou Luofu, the marshal both suppressed the dangerous intentions of the Yaoqing foxians and warned the Xianzhou Luofu to refrain from repeating its mistake.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: That was a necessary trade-off. The Xianzhou Alliance is not solely about the Xianzhou natives. Only when all three races — Foxian, Vidyadhara, and Xianzhou natives — form an alliance will there be a promising future for all.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Thank you for enlightening me. Was it for the same reason that you "traded off" my mentor to the Xianzhou Zhuming, only to stand idle and allow the resurgence of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus?
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: You said that I couldn't bear to cut out the malignant tumor within the Alchemy Commission but instead exiled the healer who tried to solve the problem to the Xianzhou Zhuming...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: But did your mentor tell you... her "good intentions" led her to perform certain healing arts on Dan Heng, who had just finished his hatching rebirth, so that he would regain the memories of his past life?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: What did you just say?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng and Lingsha

rows.text: She believed that restoring the High Elder's knowledge of his past life would allow the Vidyadhara to resume their duty as the guardians of the Ambrosial Arbor, quelling the strife within their clan and bringing everything back on the right path.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: But just as I mentioned earlier, the road to catastrophe is always paved with good intentions. Since then, the Six Charioteers decided that the Alchemy Commission would no longer have a Cauldron Master, until your arrival now.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: If that's the case, I should thank you for protecting my mentor by exiling her, General.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Quite the contrary. I should be the one thanking you.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Thanking me?
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: All I ever want is to have a clear conscience. However, can long-life species truly achieve that goal in their long-drawn lives? For example, you were implicated along with your mentor and forced to leave your homeland without knowing the truth.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: And now, with the complicated situation in the Alchemy Commission, the Alliance has spared me a lot of trouble by sending you to handle this challenging task. Shouldn't I be thanking you instead?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: ...Your eloquence is indeed impressive, Divine Foresight. You won't even leave me any excuses to hold a grudge against you.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: But let me make it clear: The Alliance sent me here to handle the business impartially, not to choose sides.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: It doesn't matter which side you choose, Miss Lingsha. At the end of the day, both you and I stand on the side of the Alliance, don't we? Let's keep going.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: A mess of bodies, a fierce battle must have been fought here.
(Examine the mara-struck remains)
These mara-struck soldiers... don't appear to be escaped prisoners.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: How can you tell?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: These soldiers are fully armed. Obviously, they didn't hastily join the battle.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: The messenger named Moze did say that there were two groups of attackers. The other attackers, aside from the borisin, could hide their tracks. I believe he was referring to these people.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hide their tracks?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Exactly. I've engaged with these attackers before, and they used cloudhymn magic to hide their presence. Without careful observation, no one can detect them.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You once warned me to be cautious of the Vidyadhara Elders' influence within the Alchemy Commission. Could it be...
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: What's on your mind, Miss Lingsha?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Well, it seems that someone provided the attackers with a map of The Shackling Prison. And considering the Vidyadhara's involvement in the prison's construction, it raises suspicions about their role in this.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Additionally, the fact that the borisin need medicine to disguise themselves suggests that there are still moles within the Alchemy Commission assisting them covertly.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Moreover, forging official identities for the undercover borisin would require someone with significant authority.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: You know why I'm letting you go? Because foxians like you always obediently return to their masters... no matter how far they run away.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: And the presence of assassins capable of using cloudhymn magic deepens my suspicions about the Preceptors.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: You're back, Jiaoqiu.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: But why would the Vidyadhara collude with the borisin and aid in Hoolay's escape?
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: They aim to spread chaos. They believe that only in chaos can they regain their former power and influence.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Since the Sedition of Imbibitor Lunae, the once-proud dragon race has been powerless, watching their influence wane. Being a native of the Luofu, Miss Lingsha, I believe you understand the implications.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A sickening crack of bones echoed through the small courtyard. There was no scream, not even the sound of a struggle.

However, I don't think the Preceptors are the true masterminds. If I'm not mistaken, the one behind all this treachery is the Lord Ravager who exploited the weaknesses within the Luofu and instigated the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus, ultimately leading to the Ambrosial Arbor's resurrection — Phantylia.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Please remember, General, that everything I've mentioned is mere speculation. We need concrete evidence for a public trial. If you want to interrogate someone within the Vidyadhara's ranks, you'll need irrefutable proof.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: So, what's your plan, Miss Lingsha?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I'll send an "invitation" to the Preceptors.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: An invitation?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Preceptors have been inviting me for a personal meeting since my arrival on the Luofu. Now, I'll send them the remains of these mara-struck soldiers and the route map I found in the prisoner's possession. Then, I'll ask them to meet me at Scalegorge Waterscape.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: I'd like to hear their explanations.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Good idea. If I were to take action, it might alert the true mastermind. I trust you to handle this matter, Miss Lingsha. The internal affairs of the Vidyadhara should remain under their jurisdiction.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: And don't worry if things don't go smoothly. Once the Wolf Hunt operation is over, the hidden truths will come to light.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Speaking of the Wolf Hunt operation, I'm truly worried about the Yaoqing messenger who was taken hostage. Hoolay was starving in The Shackling Prison for centuries... I don't know if the messenger can survive in that wolf's clutches.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: May Reignbow's blessing keep him safe.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text:
Two dual-hours before the Wardance convenes

Exalting Sanctum
As I said, I'm a healer, but my art of healing requires the culinary arts to be truly effective.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: The magic of my {RUBY_B#hot pot}cauldron{RUBY_E#} is its ability to make all kinds of medicines into dishes that patients can eat. When simmered and cooked together, any kind of medicinal herb or ingredient becomes a delightful delicacy.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Delicacy... but isn't that just one flavor overpowering the others?
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Well, you have a point... Let me ask you this: If there's a fussy child who refuses to eat green peppers, what's the best way to make him eat them?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Stuff the kid's mouth with the green peppers and cook him alive in a pot.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: The tall man stretches out a finger and touches your shoulder blade with a movement so fast it's not visible.
It's as if a dagger has cut away a piece of flesh, and the pain pierces down to the bone. You can barely stand.

Hahahaha! You have quite a sense of humor. I've heard that you borisin have lost many of your taste buds during the self-modification process, so you can't experience complex flavors. Only the "saltiness" of blood and flesh truly awakens your appetite.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: It's a shame I don't have any green peppers right now. Otherwise, I'd happily stuff them into your mouth and cook you alive in a pot.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: I'm just kidding. The answer is quite simple: Chop up the peppers and mix them with minced meat to make meatballs. This way, the flavor of the meat overpowers the taste of the peppers, and even a fussy child can enjoy them.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Can I just boil your tongue in this hot pot? I know you're trying to buy time until someone comes to your rescue.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: You said that Jingliu recently returned to the Luofu, right? Well, she did come back... but unfortunately, I also found out that she committed serious crimes and was escorted to another Xianzhou ship.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Do you really think you can delay our departure by provoking Lord Hoolay's desire for revenge with your clever little tongue?
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: You see borisin as savages who know nothing about the Xianzhou, but in fact, we know all about your tracking tricks... like the jade abacus you're carrying and the cycranes in the sky.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Nothing seems out of the ordinary in the harbor. You're filled with anxiety.
The more hope you hold in your heart, the greater your pain will be when death comes. I wonder if you can maintain your composure when I tear your throat open.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: His composure is only a temporary effect of the medicine, and it will wear off soon, right?
Lord Hoolay.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: You pathetic foxians. For thousands of years, we were the ones who allowed you to live and who granted you civilization, but in the end, you chose to betray us for the "freedom" promised by the Xianzhou people.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: But it's alright. As long as you catch the scent of your {RUBY_B#borisins}masters{RUBY_E#}, you obediently return to us... no matter how far you run away.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: (Refute him by pointing out that they are the runaways)
(Sow discord between Mok Tok and Hoolay)
Run away, you said? Well, I'm not the one who's trying to run away right now.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Hoolay, have you ever wondered why it took them seven centuries to come to your rescue?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: The borisin's era has long passed. Did they ever tell you these harsh facts before giving you hope for returning home, Lord Hoolay?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Now they're being crushed by the Merlin's Claw of the Yaoqing... by a foxian. They're hiding in remote corners of the cosmos, trembling with fear, like a wounded beast on its last legs, reaching out desperately for any fake hope of salvation, which in this case is you.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: The Merlin's Claw of the Yaoqing... A foxian? Very interesting. Tell me, Mok Tok, is he speaking the truth?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: ...He isn't lying. That lowly beast was a war slave who ran away from our pack! Cannon fodder! A thief! She stole our power and used her knowledge about us to fight us, using every dirty trick in the book...
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: And she bested you, Mok Tok. Fairness is but a pathetic excuse for the dead and defeated. Since our great pack has fallen apart, who told you that I was alive? And who sent you here?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: A foxian with a cold expression gazes at Jiaoqiu. There is sharp pressure to the gaze, carrying as if a warning to the healer that says: "Every clever little thought you bear might lead to severe consequence you will come to regret."
In our darkest hours, it was a Prophet of the Master of Immortality, named Mangas, who showed us the way. Her guidance brought us hope.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: This Prophet Mangas... What does she want?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: The Prophet made this proclamation: The borisin have been divided for too long, and only your return can unite all the packs, restoring us to our former glory! That's when we learned that you were still alive... It must have been a manifestation of the Master of Immortality!
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: And the Prophet told us that the foxian general of the Yaoqing would take you to her ship during the Luofu's Wardance, and that it would be our best chance to infiltrate and free you from your prison. And just as she said, we did it!
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: (Refute him by pointing out that their plan has not succeeded yet)
(Sow discord by pointing out Mangas' ulterior motives)
Even if you managed to set Hoolay free, you'd have no way to escape.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: We've already prepared our ships, and the Prophet's prediction will surely come true.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: That so-called prophet lied to all of you. She just sent you here to die.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: But her prophecy has come true! Our Warhead is right here, with us!
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Once the news about the prison break spreads, the Cloud Knights will close all the ports. You may think you've escaped the prison, but you're just trapped in another cage known as the Luofu.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Let me kill this unruly lowly beast, Lord Hoolay! I assure you that our starskiffs will soon arrive.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Right now, everyone in the Luofu is distracted by the stupid Wardance, so this will be the perfect chance to escape. Once you've returned to your territory, your revenge against the Xianzhou ships will be within reach.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Perfect chance? To return to my weak and shattered pack, at the mercy of a ridiculous false prophet, and become a mere puppet in her clutches? Heh, her plan is full of flaws. The only paths she has prepared for you are escape and death.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Understood. Please come to me if you need any help.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: Listen up, a wolf never allows itself to become prey. From now on, you'll follow my orders.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Wait... I recognize you... You're the lost Yaoqing messenger. How are you here?
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: Understood. Please come to me if you need any help.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: Since you are so confident that the Cloud Knights will close the ports, Jiaoqiu, I'm now giving you a chance to go and see it for yourself. Go to the ports, come back, and tell me what you saw.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Hey, although we're short-staffed at the moment, if there's anything I can do to help, please feel free to ask me.
rows.speaker: Realm-Keeping Orderly

rows.text: ...Borisin? Here? Are you serious?
rows.speaker: Realm-Keeping Orderly

rows.text: ...Wait, what did you just say?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Hey, although we're short-staffed at the moment, if there's anything I can do to help, please feel free to ask me.
rows.speaker: Realm-Keeping Orderly

rows.text: But my Lord...!
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Would an alpha wolf ever listen to a cub, Mok Tok?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: No, I've never heard anything like that... I... I wasn't trying to defy your will. I will always unquestioningly follow your orders.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Why don't you send your people?
What game are you playing?
I'm offering you a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Don't you want to run away, Jiaoqiu?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Just a little pre-hunt entertainment. Don't you want to run away?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: You will come back, because foxians like you always obediently return to their masters... no matter how far they run away.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: (Examine his injuries)
Do you know where we are?
Let me take a look. I can help you out.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Do you know where we are right now?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: (Although Hoolay and his followers can currently hide in the city, it won't be long before they're found. What was he planning when he let me go?)
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: I don't want to die yet...
rows.speaker: Injured Fugitive

rows.text: I don't fully understand Lord Hoolay's intentions, but don't think you can simply run away. Understood?
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Head to the port and report back to me. Let's see if they really closed it like you expected.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: You look exactly like a foxian...
So, that's how you managed to infiltrate the Xianzhou ship. If I hadn't been so familiar with the scent of borisin, I wouldn't have been able to tell.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: (Someone is keeping an eye on me... No, I can't get too far away.)
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: (I can't believe he actually let me go... What game is he playing?)
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: (Perhaps I can try to warn the Cloud Knights... No, perhaps I can just escape...)
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: (Look around)
(Just as I suspected... he's testing me.)
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: (Continue towards the port)
(The Cloud Knights must have been aware of the situation inside The Shackling Prison for some time. Will General Feixiao personally lead a squad to capture Hoolay?)
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: (For now, I'll do as he asked.)
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Yes, but we have several passengers...
How many passengers can you accommodate?
Well, my little starskiff can't accommodate that many... but I have a larger one that will arrive in less than fifteen minutes if you need it. So, where would you like to go?
rows.speaker: Starskiff Pilot

rows.text: Have the Cloud Knights closed the ports?
I want to get outside the Jade Gate. Can you take me there?
Can we keep this quiet?
Closed the ports...? Why would they do that?
rows.speaker: Starskiff Pilot

rows.text: What? Are you joking? How can I take you beyond the Jade Gate in this tiny starskiff?
rows.speaker: Starskiff Pilot

rows.text: Keep what quiet? Hahahahaha! Come on, spill it if you have something to say.
rows.speaker: Starskiff Pilot

rows.text: Can you give me a ride out of here?
Could you deliver a message to the Realm-Keeping Commission for me?
Never mind. I just wanted to ask if your starskiff is safe enough.
You want to leave alone now? Sure, the starting fare is six strales. Where do you want to go?
rows.speaker: Starskiff Pilot

rows.text: The Realm-Keeping Commission? It's right up ahead. Look, I've got a business to run, so why don't you go there yourself?
rows.speaker: Starskiff Pilot

rows.text: Hah! I've been in this business for almost a century! You won't find a safer starskiff around here!
rows.speaker: Starskiff Pilot

rows.text: I'm ready to leave whenever you are.
rows.speaker: Starskiff Pilot

rows.text: The Realm-Keeping Commission orderly is not accustomed to handling emergencies like this one. Understand if you thoughtlessly ask him for aid, you will reap severe repercussions regardless if the outcome is a success or failure. ...Remember: Be mindful of your words and actions.
I'm sorry, but the Realm-Keeping Commission Chancery is currently closed. All the officers and officials have been reassigned to assist in the Wardance.
rows.speaker: Realm-Keeping Orderly

rows.text: If I can help you...
rows.speaker: Realm-Keeping Orderly

rows.text: Hi, do you need my help, messenger from the Xianzhou Yaoqing?
rows.speaker: Realm-Keeping Orderly

rows.text: Borisin are hiding in the Exalting Sanctum. You must deliver this news to the Cloud Knights.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: The Cloud Knights Soldier on duty here is alone and without reinforcements. Understand if you thoughtlessly ask her for aid, you will reap severe repercussions regardless if the outcome is a success or failure. ...Remember: Be mindful of your words and actions.
Hey there, I noticed you've been looking at me for quite a while. Do you need my help?
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: Could you please provide more details?
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: What!? Are you sure about that?
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: May I ask why?
What if the Warhead wants to leave?
Can't you just stop asking?
rows.speaker: Suspicious Ferryman

rows.text: You're not one of us, but I smell a familiar scent on you.
rows.speaker: Suspicious Ferryman

rows.text: Have the Cloud Knights closed the ports?
The Warhead wants to know if we can leave now.
No, not at all. Instead, the Sky-Faring Commission is clearing routes to prioritize starskiffs heading to the Skysplitter. This will make our ships more noticeable when we try to escape.
rows.speaker: Suspicious Ferryman

rows.text: Not yet. There's no way for this tiny ship to escape from the Xianzhou. Only the starships at Stargazer Navalia can break through the Jade Gate. Mok Tok said there would be insiders to pick us up, but I haven't heard anything yet.
rows.speaker: Suspicious Ferryman

rows.text: You can sense someone staring at you from not far away.
Wait... I recognize you... You're the lost Yaoqing messenger. How are you here?
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: I was brought here by the borisin. Please make sure to report this news.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Alright, I'll call for reinforcements.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: I was brought here by the borisin. Please make sure to report this news.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Alright, I'll call for reinforcements.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: What exactly is happening... We should have received word from Stargazer Navalia long ago.
rows.speaker: Suspicious Ferryman

rows.text: (The ports haven't been closed... What is going on?)
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: You can sense someone staring at you from not far away.
These borisin are disguised as foxians. Please warn the Cloud Knights immediately.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Will you please wait here for a while? I'll find a soldier.
rows.speaker: Realm-Keeping Orderly

rows.text: (Stalling won't help... It's time to confront Hoolay and see what tricks he's up to...)
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: ...Borisin? Here? Are you serious?
rows.speaker: Realm-Keeping Orderly

rows.text: These borisin are disguised as foxians. Please warn the Cloud Knights immediately.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Will you please wait here for a while? I'll find a soldier.
rows.speaker: Realm-Keeping Orderly

rows.text: You were closely watching me, weren't you? And if I sought help from anyone, your people would kill them... Was that your plan, Hoolay?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Come and take a good look. Who are these people?
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Come and take a good look. Who is this person?
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: This Cloud Knight says there's official business that requires my cooperation.
rows.speaker: Starskiff Pilot

rows.text: Don't worry, this captain will help us.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: This Cloud Knight will help you.
rows.speaker: Realm-Keeping Orderly

rows.text: What are you trying to do, Mok Tok?
What are you trying to do, Mok Tok? They have nothing to do with this!
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Nothing to do? I told you to go to the port and check out the situation... but I never gave you permission to talk with others.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Remember, these people died because of you.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Remember, this person died because of you.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: You want to prove to me that... you hold everyone's lives in your hands, right, Hoolay!?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Exactly as you said. So, have the Cloud Knights closed the ports?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: They don't want to publicize my escape. I understand. It's no surprise, for fear is more deadly than claws and fangs... especially during a festive time like the Wardance.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: What lurks here is not a group of fugitives, but rather a pack of wolves amidst the flock. My cubs are hungry, ready to feast on flesh and blood, reveling in your fear.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Your calm facade will soon crumble. I can tear through it and expose your pathetic bones anytime. There's no escape from me, Jiaoqiu.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Of course, you can try your luck and believe that your wits will save you. But remember, you're not the only hostage in this city. If you try anything funny, innocent people will die because of you.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Now, let's talk about the foxian general you serve. Mok Tok says she's here for me, which means she'll be hunting me herself.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Before the hunt begins, I need to know my opponent. You can refuse and play tough, or you can cooperate and save us both some time, healer.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: (Show weakness, making him believe you've surrendered)
(Refuse, letting him know you won't talk)
Agh...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Good, at least you didn't try to draw attention with a scream. That way, no one will die in vain.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: But remember, the next time you refuse me, I'll crush your healing hands, then your knees, then your spine... I'll dismantle you piece by piece until only your silver tongue remains for you to speak.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: ...Fine, I'll tell you what you want to know about her, but I expect something in return.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: What makes you think you're still in a position to negotiate with me?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: You can torture me until I talk, or... let's save us both some time, Warhead.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Here's the question that's been bothering me: How have you managed to survive and endure centuries of torture? Borisin aren't supposed to live that long or possess such regenerative abilities.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: So, is that why the Xianzhou Yaoqing wanted to take me away? To some, I'm a hostage, but to others, I hold the secrets they desire...
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: I still remember, in the early years of my captivity, the foxians came and went... They extracted my blood and marrow, trying to unravel the mystery of Moon Rage. They wanted to conquer their fear of the borisin and free themselves from their bloodline.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Unfortunately, they failed to uncover the secret, so they resorted to the most brutal punishments they could imagine.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Some seek power to destroy their enemies, while others seek power to become their enemies... Which one are you, Jiaoqiu?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Ah, I see! You're the most pitiful of them all, healer of the Yaoqing! You seek power to share it with others and do good.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Well, then let me tell you the answer you seek.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: In our ancient legends, Duran, the ancestor of the borisin, was dissatisfied with his limited lifespan and power. He yearned to dominate the skies and become the master of all the stars.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: To achieve his goal, he sacrificed the lives of countless borisin and foxians, pouring them into the spring bestowed by the Master of Immortality. Through a form of genetic sorcery, the water gave birth to a miracle — the Lunar Embryo.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Duran ascended {RUBY_B#Moon}the birthing bed{RUBY_E#} and obtained what he desired: A heart in the shape of a deep-red full moon. He cut open his chest and replaced his original heart with this crimson moon.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: How typical. Just another borisin myth...
I'm not buying your absurd myth!
Laugh all you want, but only I know the truth behind every word.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: The Ambrosial Arbor is also an absurd myth, but you Xianzhou folk know it's true.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: This moon heart beats within the body of every generation of the Borisin Warhead. In the ritual that decides the new Warhead, the successor cuts open the previous Warhead's chest and consumes the divine heart, thus possessing it as their own!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Devouring is the true essence of life, allowing us to endure and thrive. It gathers the life essence of all the prey we consume, making us stronger and stronger!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: I thought all hope was lost after seven centuries of torment, but now, this heart is beating once again.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Alright, now it's your turn to tell me... everything about the Merlin's Claw.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Jiaoqiu... I've found you.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text:
Two dual-hours before the Wardance convenes

Stargazer Navalia
I know I'm in no position to question your orders, but if I understand correctly, you already have intelligence about the borisin?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: That's right. My people are busy collecting clues now. What's the situation, Moze?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: General, before we completely lost contact with Jiaoqiu, I picked up a signal from his jade abacus. It won't take long before we locate their whereabouts.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: If that's the case, shouldn't we immediately go there and join forces to eliminate the borisin? Why are we returning to Stargazer Navalia?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Looks like your general has only taught you swordplay, not the art of The Hunt.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: There's an old saying among the borisin: "In the forest, the hunter may easily become the hunted." While we may call ourselves the hunters now, chasing them blindly will only make us become the prey.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: How can Hoolay... possibly hunt us down?
But we have the advantage in numbers, right?

Are you joking, General? He's just a wolf who's been imprisoned for seven centuries. Even with his accomplices, they're no match for us numerous Luofu Cloud Knights. How could he consider us his prey?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Do not underestimate the enemy. Hoolay is not an ordinary borisin that can be easily killed. The advantage in numbers means nothing when we face that monster.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: A vicious beast, who hasn't tasted blood and flesh in seven centuries, is now lurking on the streets of the Luofu right before the Wardance. This is what makes the situation treacherous and unpredictable.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: To him, the lives of ordinary people are just meat, ready to be devoured at any moment...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Exactly. That's why we must succeed in our first strike, or the situation will spiral out of control.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You've heard of this military tactic, right? When you surround your enemy, leave one side open for them to escape. A skilled hunter must be well-prepared, waiting for the prey at the most advantageous position.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Where do those borisin want to go?
Is Stargazer Navalia the most likely place for them to come to?

What would we do if we were the escapees from The Shackling Prison? While we can disguise ourselves and blend in with the crowd, we don't plan on staying here for long. In this case, what do we need most now?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: ...A starskiff to get us out of the Luofu. The borisin we discovered at Stargazer Navalia were actually preparing a vessel for their escape.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: We predict their next move, and we take them down.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Let's start from where you found those borisin and corner our prey.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: This is where we ran into the borisin last time. It looks the same as usual.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Because I blocked all the relevant news, to make it seem as if nothing had happened.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Will the borisin notice something?
Yanqing may have alerted the borisin?
Losing contact with their accomplices preparing the starskiff will surely put them on guard.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: If Yanqing hadn't scared them off, we would not have many clues.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: However, the more well-prepared a plan is, the longer it takes to adjust when it's disrupted. If any borisin wants to stick to the original plan despite the risks, they'll surely come back to Stargazer Navalia to check the situation.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Are you suggesting that there are borisin here at Stargazer Navalia, right now?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: This is an automated area, so don't you think that there are a bit too many people here today?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: First, look at those two Sky-Faring Commission staff members. They've been observing us in secret since we arrived here.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Then, there's a Cloud Knight soldier over there. Perhaps he's here for patrol, but each patrol team must consist of two members, and obviously, he's not following the rules.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Lastly, there's that craftsman wearing Artisanship Commission clothing. He's unusually focused on checking that device.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: If you have a target in mind, let's go investigate.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Who are you? Don't you know that Stargazer Navalia is on lockdown now?
rows.speaker: Agitated Employee

rows.text: Hey, chill out. They're just a few lost tourists.
rows.speaker: Mild-Mannered Staff

rows.text: Stargazer Navalia is on lockdown now?
...But Stargazer Navalia is the shipbuilding port of the Xianzhou Luofu. If the Sky-Faring Commission called for a lockdown, there should be official documents proving it, right?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Official documents? Of course, there are. The Cloud Knights are aware that some people have infiltrated this port.
rows.speaker: Agitated Employee

rows.text: ...That makes perfect sense. So, you're now investigating the borisin?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Yeah, we've received orders from the higher-ups, so we've blocked off this area to prevent any interference with our inspection. Thank you for your understanding.
rows.speaker: Mild-Mannered Staff

rows.text: Ahh... Ah! Lieutenant Yanqing! And General Feixiao?
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: You're aware of the borisin prison break, right?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Yeah, I've received the news, and I'll be on the alert!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: Looks like you've been keeping an eye on the Skysplitter. Have you noticed anything unusual?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: No, everything is normal on the ship. Nothing out of the ordinary!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: (Question his location)
(Ask about the Skysplitter)
This is not a location for a Cloud Knight on guard duty, is it?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Well, this spot offers a great view. Are you here to keep an eye on the Skysplitter?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Yes...
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: You've been observing the Skysplitter for a while. Have you noticed anything?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Honestly, just watching the ship from here isn't too thrilling. I wish I could go on board and witness Lieutenant Yanqing's contests...
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: Speaking of which, Lieutenant Yanqing, aren't you supposed to be on the Skysplitter? Is it alright for you to be here instead?
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: Thank you for your concern, but I have more pressing matters to attend to.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Ah...
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: (End the questioning)
You're on duty, soldier. Stay focused!
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Yes, ma'am!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knights Soldier

rows.text: Hey, you there! Please refrain from wandering around Stargazer Navalia if you're not... Oh, it's you, Lieutenant Yanqing.
rows.speaker: Artisanship Commission Craftsman

rows.text: Is Stargazer Navalia on lockdown now?
Aren't you wandering around here as well?
No, not at all... Actually, I'm here to address a peculiar issue.
rows.speaker: Artisanship Commission Craftsman

rows.text: I'm an official staff member assigned to investigate a peculiar issue.
rows.speaker: Artisanship Commission Craftsman

rows.text: A peculiar issue?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Yeah, we've had some unscheduled starskiffs being constructed at this dock in Stargazer Navalia. Could there have been an error in the production planning for the assembly line?
rows.speaker: Artisanship Commission Craftsman

rows.text: This is just weird. I thought all the pending starskiffs from before the Wardance had been scheduled already.
rows.speaker: Artisanship Commission Craftsman

rows.text: I'm sorry, but I need to focus on my work right now. If you have any questions, we can discuss them later.
rows.speaker: Artisanship Commission Craftsman

rows.text: So, it seems that some borisin have returned to Stargazer Navalia in disguise. The answer seems quite obvious...
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: The staff members from the Sky-Faring Commission.
The Cloud Knight soldier.
The craftsman from the Artisanship Commission.
That's my suspicion as well.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I believe he was just slacking off. In my opinion, the staff members from the Sky-Faring Commission appear more suspicious.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I think he's genuinely here to investigate the starskiffs, as he claimed. In my opinion, the staff members from the Sky-Faring Commission are the most suspicious.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Remember when I mentioned that the Cloud Knights blocked all relevant news, to make it seem as if nothing happened? Stargazer Navalia is not under lockdown.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: But on the contrary, those staff members used "Stargazer Navalia is on lockdown" as an excuse to persuade us to leave. This contradicts the Cloud Knights' plans.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Their flimsy disguise has been exposed. Even if they try to hide, there's no way they can escape us.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Why are you still here? As I said, Stargazer Navalia is on lockdown now.
rows.speaker: Mild-Mannered Staff

rows.text: No, I never issued such an order.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Who are you?
rows.speaker: Mild-Mannered Staff

rows.text: Perhaps you haven't met me on the battlefield, but I'm certain you've heard my name. Now, I'm asking you a question, so answer me! Tell me...
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: How many more of your comrades are here? Where were you planning to meet Hoolay?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: This woman... She's the general of the Yaoqing! What are you still waiting for!? Attack her!
rows.speaker: Agitated Employee

rows.text: Why don't you kill me?
rows.speaker: Wolftrooper

rows.text: Because I need answers.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You were our war slave, so you should know us descendants of Duran...
rows.speaker: Wolftrooper

rows.text: You want me to talk? Fine, try whatever you want, but I assure you, you won't get anything from me... only fangs and blood.
rows.speaker: Wolftrooper

rows.text: If I were to do that, I wouldn't be any different from you.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I am the arrow that pierces the wolf's heart. I grant you a swift death.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: ...That's exactly what I desire. Wolves that leave the pack are prepared for the fate of never returning home.
rows.speaker: Wolftrooper

rows.text: But sadly, you didn't catch my partner... He will alert them...
rows.speaker: Wolftrooper

rows.text: Before you close your eyes, you should know that I allowed him to escape, because he will lead the Cloud Knights to Hoolay's hideout.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Arrrghhh...
rows.speaker: Wolftrooper

rows.text: Is this how you... "leave one side open"...? You let that borisin escape so you could track him.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: This is the most common hunting tactic used by borisin.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I know the methods of these abominations all too well. They always leave an escape route for their prey, allowing them to flee in fear. Then they chase them like it's a game. Borisin get great satisfaction from the last struggles of their victims...
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Have you witnessed these things firsthand? That guy called you a... war slave... What exactly have you experienced?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Well, just a hazy past that I can barely recollect. Long ago... I was one of them.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Wait, you're a borisin!?
But you're a foxian, right?
The word "borisin" was only used to refer to those wolf masters. I'm a foxian who was born in one of the "fallen territories"...
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: In their eyes, we're mere consumables, cannon fodder used to slow down Xianzhou attacks on the battlefield.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Not all foxians are lucky enough to be born on a Xianzhou ship... I grew up in one of the worlds where borisin roam, known as the "fallen territories" by the people of the Yaoqing.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: To the wolf masters, foxians are nothing but property, cannon fodder used to slow down the Xianzhou attacks on the battlefield.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: But you... survived. And not only that, you became the general of the Yaoqing! If I get the chance, I'd love to hear stories of your past, General.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Speaking of stories, you've reminded me that now is not the time for them. Moze, we've sent the "warning" from Stargazer Navalia. What's the situation on your end?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I've found them. Jiaoqiu is trying to stall Hoolay, and he signaled me... to not reveal myself.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: Trust his judgment, and keep watching. We'll be right there.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I believe the "warning" we sent will stop Hoolay from attacking Stargazer Navalia. What will he do next?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Are you from the Xianzhou Zhuming?
Ah. Yes! Have you been there?
Zhuming's got a climate that makes people healthy...
I want to go there one more time.
Wanna come find me when you're on vacation?
After this fight is over, then!
The hunt is not over yet. Stay safe, Jiaoqiu...
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text:
One dual-hour before the Wardance convenes

Exalting Sanctum
I'm a decent contestant too...
You? You need to perk up more!
We're too familiar with each other. It's hard to get serious.
You reckon we're all here just to play around today?
I didn't think that everyone around here would be...
Would be what?
Would be people who hide their strength!
Welcome to the world of the strong.
I heard that everyone who came aboard the Skysplitter...
...Are cream of the crop!
Could I be an elite as well?
Well, what else would I be? I'm definitely one.
Ahhh! Mom, I'm winning at life!
Who's March 7th?
Don't ask me. I don't know either!
Please... save... me...
rows.speaker: Patient's Voice

rows.text: I want to live... Doctor...
rows.speaker: Patient's Voice

rows.text: Jiaoqiu! Find a medical ingenium and give that kid a shot! Hurry!
rows.speaker: Healer's Voice

rows.text: I... I see. How is the front line?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: The borisin beast ships have already landed on the Fanghu... It won't be long before this place is overrun as well.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight's Voice

rows.text: What about General Yueyu... Any news from her? I'm her healer. I should stay by her side at a time like this.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: She asked me to tell you that she's not coming back. She must protect the Cloudpeer Telescope.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight's Voice

rows.text: General asks you to... to save that kid. The girl fought desperately just to bring us all back here alive!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight's Voice

rows.text: I've never seen such a brutal fighting style... Her body... it's like she was split open... just like...
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight's Voice

rows.text: Her blood pressure is dropping. Do you hear me, Jiaoqiu?
rows.speaker: Healer's Voice

rows.text: Loud and clear... Get me some Tumbledust! We've got to start the operation right now!
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: I... I will bring her back!
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: ...Is that why you're so determined to learn my secrets? Do you hear me, Jiaoqiu?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: I do. Loud and clear.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: So, she saved you all in that great battle on the Xianzhou Fanghu three decades ago, but to your surprise, you discovered her borisin bloodline while she was at death's door.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Mok Tok told me that she was a war slave who escaped from the Eclipse Pack. What a twist of fate. Turns out she's from the same clan as I am.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Now I understand. No wonder she displayed... such astounding power, determination, and cruelty in battle...! Turns out it's all because of her borisin bloodline. Mutt... despicable mutt.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: And she used the gift of her bloodline to destroy the borisin.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Moon Rage, a blessing for wolves, and a curse for foxes. For borisin, to have their bodies torn apart by Moon Rage and transform into a beast... is the ultimate joy, but for you foxians with poor regenerative abilities, it means certain death.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: With the burning fury in her heart, that foxian general will eventually lose her sanity and indulge in endless bloodshed. The scars on her body will not be caused by enemy weapons, but by the immense power she can't withstand. One day, she will be torn apart and die as a monster.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: And in return for her saving your life, you intend to give everything to solve this impossible puzzle.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Hoolay... do you know the saddest thing about being a healer?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: All this time, I've devoted my life to bringing back those who sacrificed their lives to monsters like you. I exhausted myself, and my hands trembled, but I believed everything I did was meaningful...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: But once again, they rushed into battle, and then I heard of their deaths. They died under your claws, in your jaws, amidst the flames of crashing starskiffs, and under the Lux Arrow of Reignbow...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Like a useless idiot, I saved a fish named "Life" out of the cauldron called "Death," only to watch it struggle and dive back into the boiling broth.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: So I asked myself, why were they so eager to run toward their death after they had recovered from their wounds? Why wouldn't they value their hard-won life? All the doubts left me feeling lost...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Heh... I can smell your desperation, all the way down to your bone marrow.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Eventually, I realized that their deaths held value. They placed the weight of their sacrifice on the living, granting us strength. With a coin forged by their deaths, they exchanged something more in return...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: The contestant from the Yaoqing, aside from the longsword on the back, also carried an electromagnetic hand crossbow.
Everything I'm doing now, following you so closely, is for just one reason: Witnessing your death with my own two eyes...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Even your death has value. It will pave the way for a peaceful Wardance and a fully cured Feixiao.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Hmph, the thoughts in your pathetic head are hardly surprising.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Did you already know this?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Yes, I did. As borisin, we understand the value of "death" more than anyone. And as a healer who has witnessed so much death, you won't be swayed by fear.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: What a shame. What a shame. Your story actually sparked a trace of respect for you in my heart.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Can you even feel "respect"... with your corrupted heart?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Of course, because I caught a whiff of my own kind in you. Unfortunately, in the end, you're still just a weak fox.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: As the Wolf's Creed goes: Gift the wolf a dead end, where new paths arise. Raise him to a doomed fate, where satiation lies. The cowards, in forgotten corners, meet their unworthy demise. Yet the valorous, in brutal battles, embrace their eternal prize...
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: That's why I'm keeping you alive for now. I want to show you how borisin truly respect their enemies.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: We will consume your flesh and blood, nourishing our own. We will crush your hopes and dreams, clearing a path for our hunt! Your feeble souls will witness a new future, a future that belongs to me!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: My Lord! We've received a message. Our arrangement at Stargazer Navalia has been discovered. We must act quickly!
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: That doesn't surprise me at all.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Mok Tok... What's that noise?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: It's the Skysplitter. The ship that the Wardance will be held on is about to set off! The Sky-Faring Commission will clear the air routes! And if our starskiffs try to escape, we'll be spotted.
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Calm down, Mok Tok! Look at you now, hiding and fearful... Where is your borisin dignity?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: As I said, I'd sacrifice my dignity for your return! As long as you can come back to the borisin packs, there's still hope!
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Hope? The borisin have forgotten the Wolf's Creed! Weak creatures put their hope in the strong, but the strong fight their way out!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Bringing me back instead of choosing a new master only proves the decline of our pack. And as for the prophet who manipulated you into saving me, she's just a liar trying to use Duran's offspring!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Mok Tok, let me tell you how the borisin will rise to power! We won't hide like rats in the streets of the Xianzhou! We will be ravenous wolves, walking amidst a herd of lambs with our fangs bared.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: But Great Warhead, our packs are not here! We can't go to war like this!
rows.speaker: Mok Tok

rows.text: Our packs are not here? Wherever I go, everyone is the pack!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Mok Tok, we're the apex predators at the top of the hierarchy.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: As wolves, we create fear. We don't become servants to it. If you're blind to the path, I will be the crimson moon that lights the way for you.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Share my crimson blood with our brethren! Use it to infect those foxians and strike fear into their hearts!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Now, you devious monkey... Come out and face me!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: ...Jiaoqiu.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: Moze... run...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: No, he can't run, and neither can you. You've come at the right time, monkey of the Yaoqing. Tell your general...
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Tell her, that I will unleash a massacre here, drowning the Xianzhou Luofu in blood. From this moment on, wolves bearing my blood will hunt on every street, feasting on the followers of that Devilish Archer.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Follow me, my cubs! We shall stride among the prey!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Gift the wolf a dead end, where new paths arise. Raise him to a doomed fate, where satiation lies. The cowards in forgotten corners, meet their unworthy demise. Yet the valorous, in brutal battles, embrace their eternal prize...
rows.speaker: Mok Tok and Wolftrooper

rows.text: Do you hear that? The rumble of the cannons... it brings back all the memories of past battles within me...
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: My return will bring back the Wolf's Creed. In my own way, I shall save our weakened pack and restore it to its former glory!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text:
The Wardance is about to commence

Skysplitter
Wow! The Skysplitter's gun salute is really loud! So this is what the Wardance is actually like? I feel like my eardrums are going to burst.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, how could they expect to attract people to come and watch if they didn't make a huge spectacle? March, you haven't forgotten what you came to do, have you?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: The bench remains silent, having witnessed the presence of many a formidable figure, including the once-renowned Sword Champion of the Luofu.
March 7th tries very hard to contain her urge to talk to the bench and nods at Yunli.
The bench gazes at March 7th's back as a single bead of sweat drops from it.
What... did I come to do?
I am here to be the ringmaster on behalf of Master Yanqing!
I am here to ensure the safety of the Wardance!
Who am I? Where am I? What am I doing here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Look around you, do you remember anything?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Ah, memories of falling from the sky into Taikiyan Stadium have come flooding back to me. We... came to compete, didn't we?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Great, you've finally gotten your memory back, and I can put down Old Mettle.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: As a representative of the Xianzhou Luofu, I will defeat all challengers!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's the spirit, sounds like you're all fired up! If you could just keep your legs from shaking so much, it would be more convincing, March.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: That was the mission my grandfather entrusted to me. You just relax and keep guard over the ring.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: As the saying goes, "The disciple takes the toil of their master." Remember, you are here under the identity of a Luofu swordmaster, taking the place of your no-good Master Yanqing as the ringmaster.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: But what am I supposed to do if my opponent for this round is super talented and just wipes the floor with me in seconds? I'm still a beginner in swordplay! I don't know where I got the confidence when I agreed to help General Huaiyan.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Come on, there's no need to worry about that. If you are defeated, then your opponent shall have to answer to me! Although, if that happens, the honor and the glory of the Xianzhou Luofu shall all be taken by the Zhuming, hahaha...
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Master Yunli, please, I'm about to compete! Can you say something that will give me a little confidence?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March. Think about the great storms that you Nameless of the Express have weathered along your many journeys. There's no doubt that you have faced far more terrifying enemies than your opponents here today, right? Don't you feel a lot more relaxed looking at it that way?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Master Yunli, I think I should drop out of the contest.
Why don't we call Yanqing back?
There's so much pressure, my stomach is really hurting. Maybe... I should just drop out of the contest?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You made a promise to my grandfather and now you want to run away? Get out there, now!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Why don't we call Master Yanqing back? What kind of master would retire at the height of their career and leave their disciple to fight in their place?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March. Your master has dropped out of the contest. This is a great opportunity for you to stick your neck out!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Stick my neck out and get my head chopped off, you mean!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What is all of this complaining about? You made a promise to my grandfather and now you want to run away? Get out there, now!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: I've trained hard in the art of swordplay over these few days. It's time for me to get in the ring and prove myself. Let's go.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Master Yunli, I don't think I'm completely ready...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March, there is no such thing as completely ready.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: So this is the Skysplitter? It looked quite impressive from the ground where I was on duty, but...
rows.speaker: Confused Spectator

rows.text: But now that I'm on board, it just doesn't seem as... big as I imagined?
rows.speaker: Confused Spectator

rows.text: Oh? And how big did you imagine this "impressive Skysplitter" to be? This big? This big, maybe?
rows.speaker: Curious Spectator

rows.text: Let me think... Hmm. I'd expect at least a four-hour journey by starskiff to the spectator seating from here. Otherwise it's simply not impressive enough!
rows.speaker: Confused Spectator

rows.text: Wouldn't that be too big for no good reason?
You're daydreaming about stuff that ain't gonna happen.
I kinda think this place is a bit cramped too.
The bigger, the better! If you ask me, the Skysplitter is nowhere near big enough and there are nowhere near enough cannons!
rows.speaker: Confused Spectator

rows.text: This warship used to have loads of cannons.
rows.speaker: Curious Spectator

rows.text: What's wrong with that? People are supposed to dream big! If you ask me, the Skysplitter is far too small!
rows.speaker: Confused Spectator

rows.text: The Skysplitter looks small from a distance, but it's even smaller than I imagined now that I'm on board.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hear that? This person gets it!
rows.speaker: Confused Spectator

rows.text: Either way, I thought that the Skysplitter would be absolutely huge, so it's not quite how I imagined it.
rows.speaker: Confused Spectator

rows.text: Are we going or not?
rows.speaker: Curious Spectator

rows.text: Seriously, the Skysplitter is nowhere near impressive enough!
rows.speaker: Confused Spectator

rows.text: Hello, is there anything I can help you with?
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Staff

rows.text: Hello, I have some questions I'd like to ask you!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...You have questions?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: May I ask, are you an invited contestant, or are you a spectator?
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Staff

rows.text: I am a contestant!
I'm just a spectator...
Then may your blade be sharp and your victory glorious!
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Staff

rows.text: Hey! Are you trying to back out before you even hit the arena? Hello, we are both Wardance competitors.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Then please continue along this passageway. You will come to a security checkpoint, and the staff there will guide you to the contestants' hall.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Staff

rows.text: Please continue along this passageway. You will come to a security checkpoint, and the staff there will guide you to the contestants' hall.
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Staff

rows.text: You see these glasses I have on?
rows.speaker: Combat Rating Enthusiast

rows.text: These Rating Glasses are a special souvenir I picked up from The Blue. If I just look at a contestant through them, they can give a combat power rating.
rows.speaker: Combat Rating Enthusiast

rows.text: Take a look at me?
(Leave quickly)
Take a look at me, then. What is my combat power rating?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Five.
rows.speaker: Combat Rating Enthusiast

rows.text: Impossible! Take a closer look! Is it scored out of five or something?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Poor little March, being bullied by a mechanical scoring system... Don't pay them any mind, let's go!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: No-no-no! Don't look at me! If you see some embarrassingly low score, then I don't want to hear it!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Miss Yunli, Miss March! This way, please.
rows.speaker: Xikui

rows.text: I was informed of your arrival by Madam Yukong and came to greet you personally.
rows.speaker: Xikui

rows.text: The news that you will be the ringmaster in place of Lieutenant Yanqing has been made public, Miss March. Just now, as I passed the contestants' hall, I overheard them all discussing this news. The most common question I heard was... "Who is March 7th?"
rows.speaker: Xikui

rows.text: If they ask you this, how will you introduce yourself? Do you have something prepared?
rows.speaker: Xikui

rows.text: March 7th, young beauty of the Astral Express.
March 7th, Yanqing's disciple.
March 7th, the invincible March 7th!
Losers have no right to ask my name.
March 7th, a young beauty from the Astral Express!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Alright! When people ask you, you might as well tell them this loud and clear.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: I am a disciple of Lieutenant Yanqing... That means that I'm also technically a grand-disciple of General Jing Yuan. When you put it like that, I'm actually a pretty big deal!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ugh! You completely left my name out... How rude!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: March 7th, the invincible March 7th!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Next time you try to bluff like that, at least make it convincing.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Hmph. Losers have no right to know my great name!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Is this some kind of villain entrance line?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Hahaha, I see you are both quite relaxed! Impressive, given the imminent danger you face!
rows.speaker: Xikui

rows.text: Miss Yunli's contestant information was registered for the Wardance a long time ago. However, as a last-minute entry, the Sky-Faring Commission has taken care of the necessary procedures for you, Miss March 7th.
rows.speaker: Xikui

rows.text: Please follow this path. The contestant hall is just up ahead.
rows.speaker: Xikui

rows.text: Thank you, Miss Xikui.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Come, let's take a look around the contestant hall.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: So, this is the contestant hall.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: There are so many people!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March, before the Wardance begins, allow me to give you one more lesson.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: My grandfather always told me that "a weapon mimics its master." That means that a person's weapon will reflect their habits and personality.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: You've seen me wield {RUBY_B#greatsword}Old Mettle{RUBY_E#} before, haven't you? Tell me, what did you observe from that?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: That Master Yunli is very strong.
Master Yunli has a fiery temperament.
Master Yunli doesn't have good taste.
