Master Yunli's Old Mettle is taller than a person. Being able to wield a weapon like that must mean that you have ridiculous strength, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Waving around such a giant weapon... Master Yunli favors using overwhelming force over strategy.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You are not wrong. My battle style has always been "simple and effective" — one cut and it's over.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Master Yunli's weapon looks so thick and heavy. I don't think you have very good taste.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I asked you to make predictions about your opponent's combat style. No one asked you to criticize my dear Old Mettle!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Observing the weapon that your opponent uses, assessing what kind of battle skills they excel at and where their weaknesses lie is the key to victory in battle. A shockingly heavy sword like mine, for example, is obviously not suited for a long, drawn-out battle. So, it would be best to find a way to drag the battle out.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Why would you tell me your weakness?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's the only way to ensure that we have a fair fight, don't you think? I don't want to see you go and lose to someone else, after all.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Now is a perfect opportunity to learn how to evaluate your opponents. Let's use the people here in the contestants' hall to practice. If you know yourself and know your enemy, you will not lose in a hundred battles.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Know myself and know the enemy... Let's see, who should I ask first?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: There's no need to rush to the ring just yet, let's get to know your opponents around here first.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: I heard that a sword master from the Xianzhou Zhuming is going to challenge Lieutenant Yanqing at this Wardance. Who do you think will win in the fight? Can you give me your analysis?
rows.speaker: Animated Spectator

rows.text: Lieutenant Yanqing, obviously! His swordsmanship is on a whole other level! I was fortunate enough to see him in person using his Flying Swords to capture a criminal in Starskiff Haven. I reckon just a few swift strikes and...
rows.speaker: Talkative Spectator

rows.text: Ahem!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Goodness! Isn't that the Xianzhou Zhuming's contestant, Miss Yunli?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Just a few swift strikes and the Zhuming swordmaster will have him on his knees!
rows.speaker: Talkative Spectator

rows.text: Argh! I came here because I wanted to meet the great Lieutenant Yanqing I've heard so much about and finally cross blades with him myself!
rows.speaker: Yaoqing Contestant

rows.text: Who would have imagined that he would take a disciple and have her be the ringmaster in his place? This is no more than running away from a fight and is a great dishonor to the Yaoqing!
rows.speaker: Yaoqing Contestant

rows.text: This last-minute replacement, March 7th, who exactly is she?
rows.speaker: Yaoqing Contestant

rows.text: (Carefully observe their weapon)
Hello, I am March 7th.
(If... if I'd known I could use multiple weapons at once, I'd have brought my bow.)
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hello, Miss. Are you here to take part in the Ringmaster's Challenge, too?
rows.speaker: Yaoqing Contestant

rows.text: That's right. I'm the March 7th that everyone's been talking about.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What!? You're March 7th!?
rows.speaker: Yaoqing Contestant

rows.text: Don't worry, I'm a newbie swordmaster who's only been practicing the art of swordplay for half a month.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March 7th... Standing before you is a seasoned Cloud Knight who has practiced swordsmanship for over two hundred years!
rows.speaker: Yaoqing Contestant

rows.text: (Tricking the opponent into underestimating me is a valid tactic too, right?)
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: She's just a little girl that has only just started training... Why was she chosen as a contestant?
rows.speaker: Yaoqing Contestant

rows.text: ...I'm not used to wearing clothes like this at all...
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: Oh! You're March 7th, the stand-in for Lieutenant Yanqing, correct?
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: That's right, and you are...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: As you can see, I am the journalist entrusted with interviewing contestants on-site.
rows.speaker: Reporter

rows.text: The borisin on the ground suddenly launched an attack. General Feixiao was concerned that this was all a diversion by Hoolay, so I requested to come to the Skysplitter and provide support.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I can't believe you ended up back here on the Skysplitter after running around all over the place. But, you're too late to enter the tournament now.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Following Grandpa's plan, our disciple March is taking your place as ringmaster... Aren't you proud of her?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: When I first heard the news, I was definitely proud, but also a little concerned...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: More manpower is always a good thing, since the Skysplitter is so large. Oh, and by the way, you should know that—
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: What's happening!?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Does it feel like the Skysplitter has slowed down? Could it be...
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Come with me, we need to check the engine room! It's the heart of the ship, so we need to prioritize its safety!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: The Wardance is about to begin. Contestants, please make your way to the arena.
rows.speaker: System Broadcaster

rows.text: The engine room is just up ahead. Let's go.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Strange, why is there no one here?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: The Cloud Knights... They're over here.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: And you should be lying alongside them...
Don't worry, children, there's plenty of space to hide your bodies over here.
rows.speaker: Fake Foxian

rows.text: Even though I truly hoped that the Wardance would go ahead uninterrupted and that I was worrying for no reason...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Now that these guys have finally shown up, it's a huge weight off my mind. Bring it on, you abominations!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: If we found two wolves in the engine room, that means that even more abominations have infiltrated other areas... Hoolay is already aboard the Skysplitter!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: There's no time to talk about this. The Wardance has already started! If my guess is correct, the borisin will most likely use the ceremony to begin their slaughter.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Let's go. We need to get to the Wardance ring!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Come with me! To the ring!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: This way, we're not too late!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Before we get the first round under way, our organizing committee would like to introduce you all to a host known throughout the cosmos — Mr. Owlbert! He is here today as our special guest host!
rows.speaker: Tournament Commentator

rows.text: *cheering*
rows.speaker: Spectators

rows.text: Let us invite our special guest host, Mr. Owlbert, to the stage to formally open the Wardance—
rows.speaker: Tournament Commentator

rows.text: Your Wardance ends here!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: The "Wolf-Hunt Mission" has finally come to a smooth end.
As the Warhead is defeated and slain, the Wolftroopers can no longer resist and are completely overwhelmed by the Cloud Knights. [Trailblazer] and Moze then find Jiaoqiu, who is at death's door.
And this time, there's one more business that must be settled with the affair around Hoolay's jailbreak...
Your so-called survival of the fittest is nothing but an excuse.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You cannot weaken my resolve, Hoolay.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You aim to instill terror within me...
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Yet, all of this is nothing but a... phantom.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: From this moment on, the Skysplitter belongs to me. And for you, dear spectators, I have prepared a true fight to the death!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Now, run for your lives!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: My apologies! The spectators that you were expecting aren't here... Everyone here actually came to see you.
rows.speaker: Tournament Commentator

rows.text: Cloud Knights, prepare for battle!
rows.speaker: Tournament Commentator

rows.text: Xianzhou soars, Cloud Knight roars! Xianzhou soars, Cloud Knight roars! Xianzhou soars, Cloud Knight roars!...
rows.speaker: Voices from all around

rows.text: I see you were ready for me.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: A small incense burner, commonly seen in the Alchemy Commission and Divination Commission, quietly smolders, its wisps of smoke nearly indistinguishable.
(Snuff it out)
You trust Lingsha's judgment. Clearly, the incense has been tampered with. It must be extinguished immediately.
*echoing the howl of the Warhead*
rows.speaker: Borisin around the stadium

rows.text: That's fine too! Since you have all prepared for your deaths, come, give me all you've got — entertain me!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text:
Three dual-hours before the Wardance convenes

Seat of Divine Foresight.
Surround your enemy, but leave one side open... This is your strategy for ensuring that the Wardance will be able to be held as usual?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Precisely. When Hoolay escaped, we should have canceled the Wardance immediately. No one can predict where a wild beast like him will attack, yet festivals and celebrations like this are likely to become targets.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: However, preparations for the Wardance were in the works for so long, I couldn't bear to announce its cancellation. So, I thought, if the show must go on, then let it go on. But that doesn't mean that the Wardance we hold today has to be the real event.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: All we need to do is swap all the spectators and contestants aboard the ship with Cloud Knight soldiers, and the Skysplitter, soaring high above, will become the ultimate battleground for our hunt.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: ...But what do we do if Hoolay is not planning to attack the Wardance?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Then we just need to draw his attention to the Skysplitter. We'll have the Sky-Faring Commission clear all transport lanes and cut down starskiff traffic. Then, when the time comes, there will be only one ship in the sky, and he will have no reason not to attack.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: General Feixiao will be in charge of scaring the wolves and cutting off their other means of escape, making him think that this will be his best way out.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Given that the borisin already have insiders on the Luofu, I will be in charge of putting pressure on them, making them focus solely on keeping themselves safe.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Very good! Then I'd better dust off my weary bones, too! I will go with the Sky-Faring Commission to guard the Jade Gate and ensure that things do not spiral out of control.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Knowing that Elder Huaiyan is part of our last line of defense is a great comfort.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: This hunt will make Hoolay understand that the arrows of The Hunt will always be one step ahead of the abominations.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: That jolt just now... what's going on? It feels like the entire ship has started to slow down?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Borisin must have actually infiltrated the Skysplitter. Based on General Huaiyan's orders... it's time for me to take action.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You guys... you're not Cloud Knights acting as borisin, are you?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You're... you're real borisin, aren't you?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The plan said that if Hoolay appears, the Cloud Knights will assemble and do everything they can to suppress him.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Master Yunli, where are you?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March, I'm below the ring!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: The hall below the ring... I remember it being this way...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm ready.
Let me rest for a bit first.
...Master Yanqing, what are you doing here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I was concerned about the safety of the Skysplitter and my dear disciple, of course!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Yanqing, the wolf you are hunting is standing above us in the Wardance ring at this very moment, facing the Cloud Knights...
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: This "Wardance" will not be seen by the people of the Xianzhou, nor will it be just a ceremonial sword fight. This is a battle to the death that offers no honor, only mortal danger. March, are you ready?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Please, I am March 7th, a swordmaster who will represent the Luofu in glorious battle!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: If my masters are going to battle, how could they go without their disciple?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: To use General Jing Yuan's favorite expression: "Since I'm already here..."
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yunli, Miss March, may your blades be sharp and your victories glorious!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: May your blades be sharp and your victories glorious!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: May your blades... Ah forget it. Let's go and make this a quick victory!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's go!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: The Wardance "Wolfhunt Showdown" starts now!
Secrets are a weapon that a hunter cannot live without. Those that have no secrets are no more than prey, cut open and waiting for death.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: What you're saying is, in your eyes, I am no more than prey that has exhausted all of its secrets and is simply awaiting its death?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Do you think you have some other escape route? Jiaoqiu, I have already peeled back your disguises and defenses layer by layer. I know all the secrets that you and your general have buried so deep.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: But you have told me all of your secrets too, Warhead.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: But you will never have a chance to use them. You will be buried with them right here. Although, you are a fortunate one...
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: After all, you will avoid having to see the tragic future that awaits your general.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: I'm sure she understands her fate far better than you ever will. One day on the battlefield, she will be overpowered by her ever-intensifying Moon Rage and finally be torn apart by her fury and transformation.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Not even {RUBY_B#Lan, The Hunt}your God{RUBY_E#} can save her from this fate... Although, THEY can lead her to liberation.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: And the only way to save her is here, in my hands.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Are you the healer or am I!? Are you really that certain of your own judgment?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: I must leave, foxian. But before I go, you know what I must do, don't you?
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Drink bloodwine... I hear it is a borisin custom to kill prisoners and drink their blood before battle to stir up their madness.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: You really did put hard work into researching us... It is a shame that this is where your journey ends.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Ah...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Are you... the healer, Jiaoqiu?
rows.speaker: Young Voice

rows.text: Is there anything that I can do for you?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: I heard that you saved me?
rows.speaker: Young Voice

rows.text: There's no need to thank me.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: If you're a healer, can you cure my Moon Rage?
rows.speaker: Young Voice

rows.text: And what if I can? Do I just sit back and watch as you head back out to die in battle? Listen to me, child, your condition is not suited for the battlefield.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Okay... Then can you "cure" war?
rows.speaker: Young Voice

rows.text: What are you talking about? I'm just a healer! All I can do is—
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: So, all you can do is heal us, and let us go "cure" war.
rows.speaker: Young Voice

rows.text: Such arrogance, young lady! This war has been waged for thousands of years, and it will only continue! What do you mean by "cure" war? All you will achieve is getting yourself killed!
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: You healers work yourselves to the bone to save people, even though there will always be sickness and death. So we will also keep fighting.
rows.speaker: Young Voice

rows.text: I cannot speak for the dead. But, I know that General Yueyu... as well as all the warriors that never returned from battle will not have died in vain!
rows.speaker: Young Voice

rows.text: Jiaoqiu, this is an order! Cure me!
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: How do we get a picky child to eat green chilis?
How do we get a suspicious and devious wolf to drink down poison?
I've already told you the answer.
...Those who have no secrets... are no more than prey... cut open and waiting for death...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Enjoy the taste of my fresh blood... Hoolay. Unfortunately, I am not a man without secrets. I still have one little secret hidden up my sleeve...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Tumbledust... I drank it a while ago, and the poison is already flowing through my veins... Sooner or later... you will begin to feel the effects.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: To Be Continued
If the most lethal poison known to this world... is able to save innocent lives... Then it can also be called a great medicine...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: I will do my best to cure you... Feixiao, I kept my promise. At the cost of this insignificant life...
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: ...bring victory to the Yaoqing.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: I—I was so scared! I thought you were a goner there! We're so lucky the general made it in time!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yanqing, that was amazing! The final blow you dealt to Hoolay, how have I never seen that before?
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: That's my special finishing move.
Was it really us who defeated Hoolay?
Do you want to learn it? I can teach you! But, I'll need some time to heal up first...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I hate to say it, but if you can teach me that move, I'll maybe admit that you're just a tiny little bit stronger than me...
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Was it... really us who defeated Hoolay? Why do I feel like he suddenly started to flag during our battle?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: It must have been our awe-inspiring righteousness that struck fear into his heart!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You really are an overthinker! What's the point of worrying about these things? Who cares why he started to weaken? All that matters is that we won!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: This hunt is finally over. Thank you for holding out so long. The Cloud Knights are withdrawing as we speak.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Lieutenant Yanqing, how are you holding up?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I could take on ten more!
General, how are things on the ground?
You saved my life there.
I can't believe you didn't tell me the plan...
I've never been better... I could take on ten more Hoolays...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Take it easy, young one, your wounds look quite severe. I'll have the Alchemy Commission healers see to you when they arrive.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: General... is everything okay on the ground?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Everything's fine. We were able to suppress the borisin attacks. When I sensed that Hoolay was not on the ground, I raced to get here as quickly as I could.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I... I thought I was done for.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I wouldn't want General Jing Yuan to lose the disciple that brings him so much pride. When I sensed that Hoolay was not on the ground, I raced to get here as quickly as I could.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: ...General, I can't believe you didn't tell me about the plan for the Skysplitter!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Don't blame me, this was your general's idea. When he learned that you gave up being the ringmaster to join my Wolf Hunt team, he insisted that I hide the plan from you. Perhaps he thought your impatience would mess things up.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Well? You may have run all over the place, but you ended up back here, did you not?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Who would have imagined that I would arrive late to the battlefield for the first time in my life? ...No, perhaps you young ones' blades were just too fast for me.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I originally thought, in the best-case scenario, you would team up and hold this beast back while protecting yourselves. However... You joined forces and defeated Hoolay! The youth are truly to be feared and respected!
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Come, we need to lock up Hoolay once again before anything unexpected happens.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Yes, I was defeated, but this was not unexpected. And regardless, you still showed your face, Feixiao.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: (Deal with Hoolay)
(Wait for a moment)
I have looked forward to this for so long. Our little hunting game has finally reached its climax... I told you before that I had a path prepared for you...
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: I promise I will cure you... Feixiao.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: No one can live forever, Jiaoqiu... This time, I must break my promise.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: No, please...
rows.speaker: Battlefield Casualty

rows.text: The familiar smell of death, like a vulture...
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: I'm sure that the people of the Xianzhou have shown you these familiar scenes countless times. But they only showed you what they wanted you to see.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: They have you fight to save the weak. But, what they never told you is that when all the pretenses of kindness and compassion are stripped away, this is how the universe is meant to be.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: When the Xianzhou is weak, they play the victim so they can win your sympathy. When they are strong, they make you their avenger and have you fight in the name of justice.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: I've found it... This is your shadow of "doubt."
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Your so-called survival of the fittest is nothing but an excuse.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You cannot weaken my resolve, Hoolay.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Blinded by the fury of your Moon Rage, you slaughtered your allies... Merlin's Claw, you have betrayed the Alliance!
rows.speaker: Voice of Huaiyan

rows.text: Your actions are no different from those of the abominations we stand against!
rows.speaker: Voice of Huaiyan

rows.text: At the end of the day, it is the blood of the abominations that runs through your veins... One day, you will inevitably become an enemy of the Alliance. Cloud Knights, formation!
rows.speaker: Voice of Jing Yuan

rows.text: You ran into the arms of your new masters' army without hesitation. You thought that you had found freedom, respect, and recognition.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: But you were wrong. They know all too well that a wolf will always be a wolf.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Now, your greatest fear is about to come true: You have become an enemy of the Xianzhou.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: This... This is your "fear."
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: You aim to instill terror within me...
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Yet, all of this is nothing but a... phantom.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: You have returned... Lord Feixiao! The Warhead has returned!
rows.speaker: Borisin

rows.text: Long live the Warhead! Lord Feixiao will grant us our future!
rows.speaker: Borisin

rows.text: It's time to return to the pack, Feixiao.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: No matter how deep the hatred you bear for the borisin... No matter how much we may consider each other enemies... I will still show you this path that you never imagined was available to you, because you made a choice...
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: You devoured the Crimson Moon. You are worthy to become the borisin's Warhead.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: What... did you say?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: The descendants of Duran who came to rescue me hoped with all their hearts that once I regained my freedom, I would be able to turn the tide of battle and change the fate of our people, allowing the borisin to return to their former glory! But this was just a dream used by someone with ulterior motives to manipulate the borisin.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: They would rather place their hopes of survival on an imaginary savior than gain the courage and strength to fight to the death. Borisin like that deserve no more than to be sent to their deaths!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: And I, a prisoner who was held captive for over seven hundred years, a criminal of war who was deprived even an honorable death in battle, would become a puppet upon my return, at the mercy of others. This is a fate that I will never accept!
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: For those who are truly strong, "foxian" and "borisin" are no more than labels. Someone who is truly strong chooses their own path.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: Do you remember your name?
I will create that new path for myself. I will pass the right to decide the destiny of the borisin on to you... former borisin war slave and future foxian ruler.
rows.speaker: Hoolay

rows.text: My name is... Tingyun. I serve as an amicassador of the Whistling Flames merchant guild on the Xianzhou Luofu...
I'd like to hear their explanations.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Welcome, Miss Lingsha. I am Preceptor Taoran.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Greetings, my honored Preceptor. It's been a while since we last touched base. I've brought a friend with me today. I believe you're already familiar with each other.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Taoran... Elder Taoran? I remember when I was exiled, you were on the verge of passing on. What's with this new look?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: All of this is thanks to your past life. Had you not been so rash, I wouldn't have had to walk such a dangerous road to free our clan, becoming this specter of my former self.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Dan Heng, you've returned twice, but it seems that meeting us fossils wasn't on your agenda. Regrettable, indeed. Now here you are to meet me anyway — life does love its ironies, doesn't it?
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: I didn't come here with Miss Lingsha today to reminisce.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Indeed. When the Cauldron Master extends an invitation, it's only proper for the Preceptors to attend.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: As the newly appointed Cauldron Master, there's been much to take care of within the Alchemy Commission. It's only now that I've had the chance to speak with you. Please forgive the delay, Elder.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: I sent over some evidence regarding the prison break in The Shackling Prison. I trust you've already looked it over.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Yes, you sent us the remains of mara-struck soldiers, a map of The Shackling Prison, and a Semblance Reversion Essence pill.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: These are the remains of assassins who used cloudhymn magic to conceal their tracks. They aided in the borisin's escape, allowing them unimpeded passage through The Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: That marked-up map is a map of prisoners' escape routes. Vidyadhara craftsmen once made blueprints for the prison's construction, so I imagine, Mr. Taoran, you have a similar map in your possession. This pill —
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Is Semblance Reversion Essence. Indeed, I helped plot the prison break in The Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: So the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus joining forces with the Lord Ravager to stir up trouble in the Alchemy Commission, the introduction of the Stellaron, and the Ambrosial Arbor's resurrection — all have something to do with the Vidyadhara?
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: That's right.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: So you admit it?
This is not unexpected, but it still brings me pain.
Are you surprised? After all, both of you were sent here by the Seat of Divine Foresight as messengers, to hear my confession, weren't you?
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: You were sent here by the general to hear my confession, weren't you? If there's even a shred of empathy in you, you should understand the reasons behind everything I've done.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Ever since the Sedition of Imbibitor Lunae, the population of the Vidyadhara has dwindled. With the high elder exiled, a few of us Preceptors had to do what we could to turn the tide. My methods might have been drastic, perhaps even incomprehensible, but it was all for one cause — the survival of the Vidyadhara.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Yet, the Xianzhou natives zealously forbid any plaguemarks and did nothing while the Vidyadhara suffered. Dan Heng, Lingsha, as Vidyadhara, you should understand the desperation behind my actions. All I've tried to do is to ensure our survival.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: I'm well aware of the challenges the Vidyadhara face. Fighting for survival isn't a sin.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: But Elder, your actions have gone beyond mere survival... You've become a beast driven solely by the Propagation, devoid of even a hint of empathy.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Oh? Despite calling ourselves a "noble draconic bloodline," at our core, we're merely bipedal beasts. The survival of our kind is paramount. If I hadn't resorted to beastly actions, the Vidyadhara might not even exist!
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: The sages show no mercy, as the old wisdom goes. When the high elder abandoned our people's survival, I had to shoulder the world's sins alone!
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Lingsha, Dan Heng, the past is behind us, but the future of the Vidyadhara still lies within your grasp. The situation on the Xianzhou Luofu has changed rapidly. As Vidyadhara, we must unite in purpose and avoid the mistakes of the previous Imbibitor Lunae.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: I was initially skeptical about the Vidyadhara's betrayal of the Alliance... But after hearing your confession, I realize that there is no point in talking about trust.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Breaking the covenant of our alliance will bring war upon the Vidyadhara. Even if we are able to have offspring again, what difference will it make?
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Once my plan succeeds, the alliance will see the Vidyadhara as their saviors, because both parties ultimately share the same interests.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Oh? So now that "survival" won't convince us, you want to talk about "interests"?
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: For a thousand years, the Alliance has been engaged in brutal warfare against the Denizens of Abundance, yet victory has remained beyond reach. Have you ever wondered why? Should the Alliance emerge victorious, they will inevitably become the next Denizens of Abundance. However, if they suffer defeat, the Alliance will face extinction.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Thus, the Alliance has deceitfully upheld this precarious balance. However, I have a way to escape from this dilemma.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: The Alliance's path to salvation lies within the secret of dragon transmutation!
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Imagine if there were a way to transform other life forms into Vidyadhara. The Alliance would then possess an endless stream of soldiers and would not need to worry about casualties.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Once the war ended, these soldiers would cease reproduction, eliminating concerns of overpopulation. This is the way to salvation for the Xianzhou Alliance, the ultimate path to end the universe's suffering under the immortality plague. Only we, the Vidyadhara, can achieve this!
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: So, you relied on this rhetoric to manipulate the ignorant members of the Vidyadhara into serving you?
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: I am deeply disappointed in you, Elder. Your thoughts and intentions are completely devoid of empathy. Cloud Knights!
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: Hold it!
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Miss Bailu!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Mr. Dan Heng, and Sister Lingsha! Everyone's... here?
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: You think I don't know why you're really here? Jing Yuan sent you here to test me, didn't he?
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: According to the oath between the Alliance and the Vidyadhara, it's forbidden to spill Vidyadhara blood on their own territory. Are you all ready to violate this oath in the presence of the Luofu's high elder?
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Dragon Lady, there's no need to panic. Elder, the Vidyadhara sacred grounds and the high elder are not to be used as pawns in exchange for your life!
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: You talk a big game, as if you have the nation and people's best interests at heart. But when it really matters, you use a small girl as your shield. It's ridiculously pitiful.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I've said it before, survival is never a sin. We are all Vidyadhara, so you should understand my intentions. And as a Vidyadhara, I will leave for you a dignified solution.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Leave the Scalegorge Waterscape immediately, and appeal to the top echelons of the Alliance. Let the Six Charioteers hold a trial and sentence me to exuviation and rebirth.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Exuviation?
You wish for rebirth?

I see right through your plans, Mr. Taoran. Vidyadhara rebirth erases past crimes... but I'm well aware of the Preceptors' dirty tricks during rebirth. You might not be you, but you will still be you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I won't forgive myself for past sins under the pretext of "knowing nothing," nor will I allow you to evade accountability.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dan Heng, I've always disliked your inability to see the bigger picture. Rebirth hasn't changed you one bit.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Miss Bailu, as high elder of the Luofu Vidyadhara, please share your thoughts at this moment.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I... I don't want to stay here. I'm tired of being pushed around! I'm not some puppet to be controlled! Please, take me away with you!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: I understand.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: As the oath dictates, members of the Alliance are forbidden from harming Vidyadhara here. But I've long since severed ties with the Alliance. Right now I'm simply a Nameless, free to come and go as I please.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The oath of the Xianzhou means nothing to the spear in my hand!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dragon Lady, are you alright?
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: I... I'm fine. Thank you for rescuing me.
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: You... you actually came here in person!?
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to hear your lofty opinions.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The public trial you seek with the Six Charioteers is inevitable. In addition, I'll write to {RUBY_B#Xuan Quan}the Seiche Queller{RUBY_E#} of the Fanghu. With her hatred for evil, I'm sure she will make a just decision.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: If it's her, she will earn the respect and assent of all the Vidyadhara on the Luofu.
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: ...In terms of martial prowess, you indeed have the upper hand. But if you're under the impression that this advantage can be used to settle the score with us Preceptors, that's quite an overestimation.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Given the Vidyadhara's foundation within the Alliance, do you really think you can do anything to us?
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: As I mentioned, I'll take all the blame and become the scapegoat.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: With the secrets I possess, the interrogation alone will take an eternity. And in the end, through various exchanges of interests, I am certain to survive. You understand this better than anyone, as it's the very art of "trade-offs" you love to wield.
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Lastly, a word of caution to you... I heard that Hoolay has escaped from prison and is headed directly for the Skysplitter. The bloodshed at the Wardance is bound to be gruesome. Perhaps, even before my trial, your impeachment will have you in dire straits first?
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Regrettably, Mr. Taoran, the Skysplitter only hosted Cloud Knights today, no audience.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: And just moments ago, Hoolay was executed by the Cloud Knights.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Heh... Haha... Hahahahaha...
rows.speaker: Taoran

rows.text: Operation "Wolfhunt Showdown" has ended. The messengers from the Realm-Keeping Commission are calming down the populace and the momentary disruption has subsided.
Meanwhile, in the Alchemy Commission, [Trailblazer] is mourning for someone...
Waaah... Miss March...
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: March 7th... I didn't think you'd...
There's so much we didn't have the chance to say...
Miss March! My dear Miss March!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: I was only in the bathroom for a little bit, and you've already arranged my death? [Trailblazer], can't you play some normal games with Dragon Lady?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This kind of make-believe adds a genuine touch!
This was Bailu's idea!
Help! It's a zombie!
Thanks a lot for that!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You really can't keep your mouth shut, can you?
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Are you amused?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Alright! Enough playing. It's time to visit my masters.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The infirmary is right over there. You can go by yourselves. Come back and visit me when you have time!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Next time, let's not play overly realistic make-believe with [Trailblazer], okay?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, there's not much I could do. General Feixiao didn't really give me any chance to shine during this Wolf Hunt operation.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: If I had been in the ring, I could've knocked down ten Hoolays with just one strike.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You sound exactly like Master Yanqing. But for now, both he and Yunli have been forced to go to the Alchemy Commission for some well-needed rest.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm the least accomplished in swordplay, but I came out unscathed. I really ought to thank my masters for taking all the blows on my behalf.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Did Master Yunli run out on her own?
Master Yanqing... didn't make it in the end?
I'm just following the doctor's advice. Miss Bailu said I could take a stroll, so here I am.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Hey, watch your words! Don't you jinx my master!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Considering the intense battle with Hoolay and then with General Feixiao... ahem, the rigorous sparring session with her! His small body couldn't take it anymore.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: ...The enemies were mostly taken care of by General Feixiao.
Now that I think about it, I didn't really have a chance to get hurt.

I heard a few versions of the story from the Cloud Knights who were there. The number of Wolftroopers went from a few dozen to thousands, and the number keeps rising. It's becoming more absurd by the minute!
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: I can guess why: General Feixiao is just too strong.
rows.speaker: Yunli

rows.text: Yunli, go and lie down!
rows.speaker: Lingsha

rows.text: The sound of those footsteps... They must belong to General Feixiao. Out and about despite the doctor's orders?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: What a coincidence! Someone else who refuses to listen to the doctor's orders.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Well, being a doctor myself, I don't think my knowledge of my own body is inferior to the Dragon Lady's.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: The healer does not heal himself. Don't try to act tough in front of me.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: ... I'm sorry, Jiaoqiu. I didn't expect you to use poison that way. What a miscalculation. If only I'd found you sooner... If only I hadn't sent you to The Shackling Prison...
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: The way you're speaking, is this really the Feixiao I know? Or could it be a borisin assassin, imitating your voice to take my life?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Jiaoqiu, your eyes... You can't see anymore, can you?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I can still clearly hear the sound of the waves. That's enough for me.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Don't blame yourself. You know what I'm more concerned about. Has your body had any changes since you swallowed the Crimson Moon?
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: I'm not sure. There don't appear to be any changes... However, the many doubts that once plagued me have dissipated.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I never thought I'd live to hear you discuss your health again... But thanks to Moze and that child, the price I've paid seems trivial compared to what we've achieved.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: I hold no grievances, Feixiao. I am content.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: ...I don't know how to offer words of comfort, nor do I know much about curing others' ailments.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I am just a warrior, so my pledge to you is simple...
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: ...An eye for an eye.
rows.speaker: Moze

rows.text: So you were here too.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: In this vast universe, there's bound to be someone who can heal your eyes. I'll find them. But until then...
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: The threat behind all this chaos needs to be dealt with.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: You must already have some ideas. Let them out.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: The resurgence of the Sanctus Medicus and the gathering of the borisin... are merely distractions orchestrated by an unseen force, meant to divide the Alliance's attention.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Unfortunately, they picked the wrong fight this time. Once we return to the Yaoqing, I'll personally lead the Verdant Knights into battle.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: ...I vow to take down a Lord Ravager and teach the Ruin Legion the true meaning of The Hunt.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: I knew it... You've always been so impatient.
rows.speaker: Jiaoqiu

rows.text: Seat of Divine Foresight
I apologize for my tardiness, once again.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: The Alchemy Commission detained me for some time for a health examination. They released me only after ensuring I was in good condition.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: General, seeing you safe and sound puts our minds at ease.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Hoolay's escape caused significant upheaval and forced the Wardance to be put on hold — a truly unforeseen disaster. Fortunately, the younger generation showed their valor. They bravely tackled the crisis, putting an end to the disaster and providing a glimmer of hope in a dire situation.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Before Master Diviner Fu Xuan's departure for the Yuque, I consulted with her about the Wardance. She left a note stating, "The hexagram oscillates between thunder and heaven, a sign of great power," assuring us that we would successfully navigate any challenges.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: She advised me to trust the younger generation's abilities and let them lead. Her predictions, it appears, have come true.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: It's just... the Xianzhou Luofu's longstanding duty of keeping Hoolay imprisoned ended with his death on the Skysplitter. This event is likely to bring much criticism from the Alliance's upper ranks.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: However, Hoolay's demise might actually be a blessing in disguise. Broadcasting this news could derail the borisin's resurgence and quash the ambitions of those who wished to take advantage of his return.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Hand over Hoolay's remains to the Xianzhou Yaoqing, and I'll handle the explanations to the Alliance.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: But, what about the Wardance? While the wolf-hunt mission was a success, the events on the Skysplitter remain a secret. However, the news of the borisin's attacks on the streets will spread like wildfire.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: The Wardance was interrupted, so it must be reconvened. As for the people who witnessed the attacks, beyond placating them, we also need to show them the Xianzhou Cloud Knights' fearless dedication.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: "On the Wardance's opening day, rogue borisin attempted to stir up panic but were swiftly neutralized by the Merlin's Claw and the Cloud Knights." A genuine tale of heroism that will captivate and calm the public.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: As Elder Huaiyan suggests, the Luofu will do its best to heal the wounded and compensate those who were affected. We aim to reopen the Wardance in the coming weeks.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: This settles the immediate concerns on the Luofu, but my thoughts linger on the orchestrator behind these events.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: From the onset of the Ambrosial Arbor Crisis, the Xianzhou Luofu has experienced numerous disturbances, directly linked to the Lord Ravager Phantylia.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Her attempt to infiltrate the Xianzhou with the borisin and sway the Luofu Preceptors to join the Sanctus Medicus' insurrection was unsuccessful. But I have a feeling that she is indifferent to the success of her plans.
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: Rather than outright victory, Phantylia's motive seems to lie in breeding discord and chaos among allies. Should the Alliance fail to mend these rifts, it risks disintegrating into a pile of sand.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The goal of the Xianzhou Alliance has not changed for thousands of years. Perhaps we should point the weapons in our hands toward this new adversary. I plan to bring this matter before the marshal following the Wardance.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: With Elder Huaiyan's insight, one wonders how the marshal will react.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: It's clear we're engaged in a game of chess not seen in thousands of Amber Eras, a game where even the strategists become pawns in battle, where the stakes are as high as the fates of countless stars in the sky.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Predicting the marshal's decision is beyond me, yet she's well aware of our concerns. She has tasked {RUBY_B#The Seer Strategist}General Yao Guang{RUBY_E#} with performing extrapolations day and night to gauge the situation comprehensively.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: We gathered today not just to tackle the Luofu's predicaments but also to address a matter requiring our collective presence.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Yao Guang has sent a message from the Xianzhou Yuque, informing us that she wishes to share the results of recent calculations she made within the matrix.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Jing Yuan, I'd like to borrow the Seat of Divine Foresight's "chess board" for this purpose.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: An ancient "bell" has been struck in the depths of the Xianzhou Yuque, its soundwaves rippling over the valleys and hills of gravity.
Thus, light bursts forth from the chessboard's grid, weaving into a seal symbolizing the Seer Strategist's authority.
Hello everyone, it's been a long time! Over three decades have passed since we last convened, and I've dearly missed each of you generals during this time ☰☰.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Was the Seer Strategist thinking of us, or thinking of the fates we're destined for?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: The Merlin's Claw, as blunt as always, ☳☶ though not everyone's cup of tea, huh?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: You once told Jing Yuan, "You're lucky that I'm the one who came this time. If it were the Seer Strategist, this conversation might not be so friendly." I'm intrigued — did that conversation really come to pass?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I've never heard anyone mention that the Deca-Light Reflection Barrier could eavesdrop on even the quietest whispers. It appears that the marshal sent not just two generals to the Luofu but an uninvited third guest as well.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: People have been saying that Mr. Jing Yuan's intellect shines as brightly as the Seer Strategist's. With the Luofu caught in such strife, the Yuque couldn't just stand by and watch.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Seer Strategist, our time with the Yellowbell is limited. Let's get straight to the point.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan

rows.text: Alright. Thanks to Mr. Jing Yuan, the interrogation of {RUBY_B#Luocha and Jingliu}the two prisoners{RUBY_E#} on the Yuque has concluded.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Mr. Jing Yuan's speculations were correct. Of the crimes they confessed to, planting a Stellaron on the Luofu was a complete fabrication, meant to mislead.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Their real aim was to secure a meeting with the marshal to present their Godslayer Protocol — a strategy they firmly believe in.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: And what was this grand strategy proposed by Jingliu and that traveler?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The narrative they painted was vast and difficult to put into words ☳☳. It all revolves around the coffin of the blond traveler...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: ...to be precise, it's the remnants of the Propagation.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: The remains of the Swarm Author?
rows.speaker: Feixiao

rows.text: More accurately, it's a fragment of the divine body. In the future they depicted, this fragment serves as the final nail, sealing the fate of the Plagues Author and securing its doom.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Before reaching that point, battling the gods necessitates a larger alliance. Hence, they sought out an ally for the Xianzhou.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: I assume you've all heard of the famed Genius Society member #81, Ruan Mei, haven't you? The "eye" of the Yuque has just seen this uninvited guest arrive on the Xianzhou Luofu.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: ...Three, two, one. Right on time! Now, as for the best way to receive our distinguished guest... I'll leave that in your capable hands.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang
